name: The Palace of the Gilded Lily
region_detail: A raised island amid the flooded forests and marshes north of Lake Ophar.
site_type: palace | Inhabited locations; faction strongholds | Royal residence and administrative seat of the Mudcrown Court.
history: Successive Mudcrown rulers have built their residences upon the island, incorporating older timber platforms, salvage from wrecked vessels, and stone brought from elsewhere in the marsh. Ulbrik VII has embellished the palace with imitations of Cadorian aristocratic architecture and heraldry.
current_state: The court receives tribute and petitions, stages elaborate ceremonies, and entertains guests whose attendance is not always voluntary. Ulbrik’s recent proclamation of hereditary sovereignty over neighboring villages has increased the number of disputes brought before Lady Vromma. The palace remains a functioning seat of government despite its precarious construction and extravagant customs.
inhabitants: King Ulbrik and his household; bullywug courtiers, guards, servants, tribute collectors, petitioners, and occasional unwilling guests.
danger_level: Moderate to high, principally dependent upon the disposition of the court and the behavior of its guests.
points_of_interest:
Ceremonial landing; raised timber palace; throne hall; banquet platforms; tribute storehouse; guest quarters; submerged holding pens; collection of royal regalia.

Unresolved elements: The precise arrangements of the palace and its defenses; The fate of previous envoys and unwilling guests; The authenticity and properties of the royal crown; Which communities continue to recognize Ulbrik’s authority.
discovery: A raised island amid the flooded forests and marshes north of Lake Ophar. Frogfolk boatmen know routes to the island. Royal messengers and tribute collectors may escort visitors to the court.
related_records:
Faction Plot: P-008 — The Frog King’s Tribute — Direct. The palace is the seat of the monarch whose territorial claims initiate the conflict.
Job: J-WB-007 — Royal Invitation! — Direct. The court receives the invited envoys; their precise fate remains undetermined.
Adventure Hook: The King’s Banquet — Direct. The palace provides the setting for the compulsory royal banquet.
Rumor: R-WB-005 — The Crown of Mudcrown — Potential. The royal regalia may include the crown described in the rumor; its origin and powers remain undetermined.

Notable individuals and factions: Ulbrik Mudcrown VII (N-072) — monarch of the court; Lady Vromma Miretongue (N-073) — administers tribute and attempts to restrain the king’s excesses; Kobb Eel-Catcher (N-074) — dissident fisherman, not necessarily present; Mudcrown courtiers, guards, and representatives of tributary communities.
